data.description:
## Context
While closing lovesick-missing-andeancat, a bounded live container-admission smoke using rebar.llm.evals.fixture_mining.heal._ProductionAttempter reached eval_solver.run_case for G3 and failed before model evaluation with RuntimeError: agentic filesystem tools was attempted OUTSIDE the repo-snapshot gate process. The first attempt also showed .rebar/fixture_heal_manifests was not created before fixture_selection.write_manifest.

## Impact
The scheduled/live fixture-heal path can be unavailable for agentic/container criteria even after the corpus contains faithful child material. This is distinct from lovesick-missing-andeancat, which fixed the persisted material and admission semantics.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The production fixture-heal live path creates its work directories before writing manifests.
- [ ] Agentic/container criterion admission runs inside gate_source.gate_read_root (attested snapshot or explicit local) rather than requiring REBAR_GATE_ALLOW_UNGATED.
- [ ] A regression test proves G3/G4 live admission reaches the solver under the required gate context or records an explicit unavailable result without crashing the sweep.
data.title: Fixture heal live run lacks gate context
